publisher: United States Department of the Treasury, USAspending
license: CC0-1.0; full license archived at raw/LICENSE
source_kind: publisher schemas only; no observed or synthetic records
source_schema: Contracts_Subawards.csv fields in official Data Dictionary Crosswalk Public columns I/J
target_schema: broker_subaward fields in Public columns M/N; declared PostgreSQL types in BROKER_SUBAWARDS_COLUMNS
scope: Explicit 27-field source and 27-field target projections of contract-subaward reporting schemas. All selected source fields receive labels; mappings are limited to these projections.

sources.archive_reuse: Exact first-tranche primary-source archive reused; source schemas only, no first-tranche predictions.
Exact first-tranche primary-source archive reused; source schemas only, no first-tranche predictions.

selection_policy: SELECTION_POLICY.md, recorded before second-tranche source selection or retrieval
equivalence_basis: The authoritative crosswalk puts subaward CSV headers and database fields on the same named concept row with a definition. For multi-table rows, database fields are aligned positionally with their table names, or a sole database name applies to all listed tables. No guessed aliases.
type_policy: Source CSV storage types are unknown because the official crosswalk does not declare storage types. Target types preserve explicit PostgreSQL TEXT declarations as text, even for amounts, dates and numeric-looking codes. No inferred numeric values or fabricated examples.
negative_policy: No-match source concepts have their exact counterpart deliberately omitted. Negatives distinguish recipient role, legal address versus performance address, an FSRS report ID versus a nonunique tracking number, and executive fiscal-year earnings versus an award amount.
ambiguity_controls: No geographic code/name alternatives included for the same entity and attribute.
No competing integer/decimal representation of a quantity.
No prime base/latest-action-date pair that shares the crosswalk database field.
No PIID/FAIN choice sharing one database field.
No competing numbered executive amounts; numbering is not claimed to establish stable officer identity or rank.

first_tranche_independence.check: Compared only original sourced labels to avoid reuse; no predictions, policy, runtime implementation or reports accessed.

reproduction: python3 extract.py; standard-library ZIP/XML/AST parsing only; no network and no publisher-code execution.
limitations: Schema-only: all sample arrays empty and no claims about observed distributions.
A curated schema projection, not a whole-table migration.
Reuses the authoritative publisher crosswalk archive from the first tranche, but selects a distinct financial reporting entity and previously unused source fields and answer pairs.
